title: DESIGN OF STRIFE NOW OPEN
lines: DETAILS: Design of Strife event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can collect Experimental Dataset by clearing event stages to level up Cogitative Diving Evaluation and obtain event rewards.
[Cogitative Diving Evaluation] Rewards ： EPOQUE Collection - Sunny Day for Cardigan, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
